ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Race, Gender and Music." Meets with AAS 390 and GWS 390. This course examines how musical cultures shape the ways in which we imagine relations of race, gender, sexuality and nation. By exploring the dynamic processes of musical production, consumption, and exchange within and through both translocal and transnational frameworks, we will develop a critical analysis of the politics of musical and cultural practice. Through interactive activities and assignments, students will engage musical sources and genres ranging from opera, musical theater, jazz, blues, soul, hip hop, and country to punk, queercore, Mexican corridos, Cuban rumba and son, Afroperuvian festejo and lando, and South East Asian psychedelia.
